name: Paint Bucket
description: A paint bucket being filled by a pouring stream, fits design and creative tools

variations.name: default
variations.description: A stream of paint pours into an outlined bucket while the level inside rises, then fades and repeats

props.name: width
props.description: Width of the loader container in pixels

props.name: height
props.description: Height of the loader container in pixels

props.name: color
props.description: Color of the paint and pouring stream

props.name: strokeColor
props.description: Color of the bucket outline and rim

props.name: backgroundColor
props.description: Fill color of the bucket interior

props.name: isAnimating
props.description: Controls whether the animation runs. Set to false to pause animation.
